purpose: prevent duplicate work between OMEGA Final Autopilot and the independent audit/support/evidence lane

before_start: list open helper support/* pull requests
compare candidate SHA against current private main
dedupe_protocol.autopilot_behavior: verify active support claims and skip reimplementation of the same goal/path/candidate until RELEASE, failure, or explicit takeover is recorded in issue #160
dedupe_protocol.support_behavior: claim before writing, use support/* branch, keep canonical private main untouched unless an exact promotion gate explicitly authorizes merge, publish evidence, then release claim

final_autopilot: private candidate promotion after exact gates

acceleration_rules: exact-SHA shallow checkout unless full history is a proof requirement
caches are restore-only in proof paths and never authority
verify runner prerequisites before network installation
reuse current support work instead of recreating it
every optimization must preserve exact-SHA, PIT, independent QA, signer and recovery guarantees
